name: data-lineage-artillery-tests
description: Нагрузочное тестирование API с помощью Artillery

scripts.test:all: npm run test:smoke && npm run test:basic && npm run test:stress
scripts.test:all:with-report: npm run test:all && npm run report:combined
scripts.test:report: artillery run basic-load-test.yml --output report.json && artillery report report.json
scripts.generate:test: npm run generate && npm run test:auto
